Residual-directory cleanup status (Fable2, updated 2026-11-20 ~18:37Z, after Greg's restart at ~18:29Z).
DONE: Sol-03d4 removed, non-forced and non-recursive, the three empty handle-held residuals .tmp/wt-b912-9474, .tmp/freeze-docsb2-2bdaf394 and .tmp/freeze-b12-c33b9326, after checking each was inside the repo, unregistered, had no reparse point and was empty (note a8724bfcb9e247058fcc725398d4081d on w-f1559f4bd64c).
STILL PENDING: .tmp/9f88-measure (Sol-a7bb #3400, 2026-11-20 ~08:47Z). Its non-forced Remove-Item failed on hidden, system or read-only Git metadata (Hidden probe/x/.git; 13 files, 17,298,445 bytes; note dccbb2af on w-9f8823dd96fe). It is not a handle hold, so it needs a forced form, which requires Greg's per-case word under AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions". Codex executes. When more such residuals accumulate, ask Greg ONCE for a per-case forced-removal word listing each exact absolute path. Until then it stays; it is small and harmless.

Added 2026-11-21 ~03:03Z (Sol-a7bb #3412): .tmp/wt-da52-9474, the empty, unregistered residual of closed DA52's worktree. After path, link and empty checks, a non-forced, non-recursive Remove-Item was refused with 'used by another process'; the holder is unknown, likely a session or evaluator shell. Handle it like the 2026-11-19 entries: leave it until the next TermAl restart releases the handle, then remove it non-forced (Codex executes) and record the result. It needs no forced form and no process stop.
